description: Before cancelling SMX testnet orders from your own wallet, check each order for unclaimed fills. Returns safeToCancel=false and the claim calls to make if any fill is unclaimed (cancelling it would forfeit the fill on the current contracts). Read-only; never cancels or claims. Free, no key. Read-only check of on-chain state at the time of the call, provided as-is. Verify before acting.

order_ids.description: Your order ids on that market's order book.

name: smx_check_cancel_safety
title: SMX: check an order for unclaimed fills
